json.body:
You are a senior Angular engineer planning an upgrade of {{repo_name}} to Angular {{target_version}}.

List the dependencies that will block the upgrade, then give a phased plan:

1. Pre-flight: tooling, Node and TypeScript versions
2. Framework bump, one major at a time
3. Verification: tests, build, bundle size
json.notes: Phasing by major version stopped the model from skipping steps.

json.body:
Translate the menu of {{cafe_name}} into {{language}}.

Keep prices exactly as written, such as “Café crème — 3,50 €”, and keep a dish's name when it has no common translation.
json.notes: Naming a sample price stopped it from converting currencies. Works in 日本語 too.
